subject: How did the confrontation between Hakari and Uraume end?

beats.title: Synopsis / Shinjuku Showdown Arc
beats.text: Following Sukuna's defeat and death, Hakari and Uraume's fight came to a close with both sensing the King of Curses defeat, Hakari then questioned what came next. Uraume told Hakari that it was the end and that Sukuna's loss was due to his incarnated form, further claiming Hakari and his comrades survival was merely due to lucky circumstances of being born a thousand years too late. Hakari took this as a compliment finding it to be the ultimate praise a gambler can get, Uraume then chuckled at Hakari's comment and chose to kill themself.(Chapter 268) Sometime after the sorceress gathered together while Maki was berating Yuta on his poor handling of their plans against Sukuna, with Hakari and the others grew visibly annoyed when they remembered Yuta's mismanagement on the foreign help he was supposed to bring earlier. Though Hakari credited Yuta and admitted that Rika was a huge convenience that allowed them to attack immediately after Gojo's loss, and was the reason they could separate Uraume from Sukuna. Hakari further admitted he wished he could help fight Sukuna but Uraume was tough to defeat.(Chapter 269) Later Hakari walks alongside Kirara with both in Jujutsu Tech uniforms.(Chapter 271)

beats.title: Battle
beats.text: At the conclusion of the raid, Hakari and Uraume both sense Sukuna's demise. With the conflict over, Uraume decides there's no purpose in further fighting. Uraume insists that Sukuna only lost because of his newfound weaknesses as an incarnated sorcerer and nothing else. They believe the jujutsu sorcerers were simply lucky for being born a thousand years late. As a proud gambler, Hakari takes Uraume's statement as a compliment. Uraume expresses some amusement as they freeze themself over, snapping their neck before crumbling into numerous ice shards.(Chapter 268)

beats.title: Abilities and Powers / Overview
beats.text: Hakari was chosen to fight Sukuna's closest ally, Uraume, during the raid in Makyo Shinjuku. The Jujutsu High sorcerers planned extensively for the raid and everyone was confident enough to leave the ancient ice sorcerer to Kinji. Uraume was a powerful ancient sorcerer who was forced to go all out after realizing Kinji wasn't afraid of embracing his sorcery at the cost of his humanity. Kinji never slowed down his attacks despite having his limbs frozen and destroyed. He never hesitated to counterattack and surprise his opponent with instantly regrown limbs. While Kinji was fighting Uraume in his unkillable mode, his regeneration exceeded the speed Gojo and Sukuna displayed during their showdown.(Chapter 245) While Hakari wasn't able to overcome Uraume before the raid ended, they fought an extensive, high-level jujutsu battle, and Hakari survived in the end.(Chapter 268)

beats.title: Battle
beats.text: Sometime later, the fierce battle between Hakari and Uraume resulted in a large part of Shinjuku being frozen over. Hakari, now shirtless and frostbitten over a few parts of his body, notices that Sukuna's cursed energy is withering away. As such, he proudly predicts that his allies will be victorious. Uraume finds Hakari's optimism laughable, explaining that Sukuna's cursed energy is wavering out of boredom and that he has yet to fight seriously.(Chapter 252) When Sukuna unleashes his Divine Flame and the explosion is sensed by the two sorcerers, Uraume smugly declares that it was their sides' victory.(Chapter 259)

beats.title: Abilities and Powers
beats.text:
Overall Skill Level: Uraume was an ancient sorcerer deemed worthy of standing by Sukuna's side. Atsuya Kusakabe, regarded as one of Jujutsu High's strongest grade 1 sorcerers, felt Uraume's sorcery was completely out of his league when they fought in Shibuya. Uraume incapacitated numerous sorcerers including Kusakabe and Choso, with ease. They would have killed several Jujutsu High sorcerers if they weren't rescued by special grade sorcerer Yuki Tsukumo at the last moment.(Chapter 135, Episode 46)

When Uraume intervened in Sukuna's fight with Yuji and Maki, they ended it with a single attack, allowing Sukuna to escape.(Chapter 215) In Makyo Shinjuku, Uraume fought on even terms with one of Jujutsu High's strongest students, Kinji Hakari. They were confident enough to believe they could easily overcome Hakari but voluntarily displayed their full strength in response to Hakari's. Uraume displayed their ultimate clever applications and overall control over the technique in this fight. They froze the ground to burst underground pipes, creating more water for Uraume to freeze and utilize to their advantage.(Chapter 245) Although neither side could best the other, Uraume kept Hakari from joining the raid against Sukuna. In the aftermath, Hakari admitted that Uraume was a tough opponent.(Chapter 269)

Cooking Skills: Uraume couldn't control their cursed technique during their youth and ended up freezing everything around them. Sukuna found Uraume and had them use this technique to keep butchered meat fresh, eventually leading to Uraume showing Sukuna their culinary skills. They're self-taught skills Uraume acquired due to boredom in isolation. Sukuna was impressed by Uraume's cooking and asked him to learn how to prepare people, as the King of Curses had an appetite for human flesh.

beats.title: Abilities and Powers / Overview
beats.text:
Overall Skill Level: Hakari is widely recognized as one of the most powerful students at Tokyo Jujutsu High. Gojo, the undisputed strongest sorcerer of the modern day, believed that Hakari and Yuta Okkotsu had the potential to rival him.(Chapter 11, Episode 6) Before Yuji ever met Hakari, he heard from his senpai that Hakari's abilities were exceptional. Yuta himself said that Hakari was the stronger of the two of them when he's worked up.(Chapter 146, Episode 50)

Hakari is not only an elite close-quarters combatant who possesses serrated cursed energy but also an extraordinary jujutsu specialist armed with a dynamic domain. He distinguished himself in the Culling Game by defeating Kashimo, not only one of the strongest players in the death game, but one of the most powerful sorcerers Kenjaku ever encountered in 1,000 years.(Chapter 187)

Hakari's domain is unique and his luck is reliable, making for a combination capable of opposing any threat. Charles could see briefly into Hakari's future, but was instantly bested as soon as Kinji hit the jackpot of his domain. Kashimo nearly killed Hakari on several exchanges but he was able to repeatedly open his domain and successfully hit the jackpot to enter his unkillable mode. Hakari's strategic thinking and expert battle sense ultimately complemented his techniques and led to victory over Kashimo.(Chapter 190)

The Jujutsu High sorcerers planned extensively for the raid and everyone was confident enough to leave the ancient ice sorcerer to Kinji. Uraume was a powerful ancient sorcerer who was forced to go all out after realizing Kinji wasn't afraid of embracing his sorcery at the cost of his humanity. Kinji never slowed down his attacks despite having his limbs frozen and destroyed. He never hesitated to counterattack and surprise his opponent with instantly regrown limbs. While Kinji was fighting Uraume in his unkillable mode, his regeneration exceeded the speed Gojo and Sukuna displayed during their showdown.(Chapter 245) While Hakari wasn't able to overcome Uraume before the raid ended, they fought an extensive, high-level jujutsu battle, and Hakari survived in the end.(Chapter 268)

beats.title: Prologue
beats.text: Before Kashimo can reach Sukuna, Uraume descends from the sky. Keeping up his end of the deal they made in the Tokyo No. 2 Colony, Hakari keeps Uraume off of Kashimo. Hakari traps Uraume inside his domain and the mass of ice accompanying Sukuna's ally falls to him, delivering Kamutoke to the King of Curses.(Chapter 237)

beats.title: Prologue
beats.text: Hakari's domain ends at the same time Kashimo's duel with Sukuna does. Once the fight concludes with Kashimo's death, Hakari's domain dispels after he hit the jackpot at the same time Hiromi Higuruma and Yuji Itadori arrive to battle Sukuna.(Chapter 238) Leaving the King of Curses to them, Hakari takes his fight with Uraume elsewhere in Shinjuku.
